description: The window's own capability. The interface's custom commands need no grant — Tauri allows an application's own commands without one — but the core and plugin APIs it calls do. Three of them: the event API, which receives the screens the desktop process asks it to open (R12) — the tray's settings entry emits `open-screen` and the webview listens for it; the updater's whole workflow, so Ajustes can ask whether a newer version exists, download it and install it (S7); and `restart`, so an installed update can be entered without the reader closing and reopening the window by hand. `process:allow-exit` is deliberately NOT granted: relaunching into a verified update and quitting the application are different powers, and only the first has a caller.
